item.title: Smart home standard Matter 1.5 adds cameras and energy reporting

item.title: EU fines chatbot maker over training data

item.description: Rail operators added a dozen sleeper routes this year, but cross-border tickets remain a puzzle for travel planners.

item.title: Thermostat makers push firmware fix after weekend outage
item.description: A bad cloud update left thousands of thermostats stuck in eco mode.

item.title: NASA's Artemis III crew begins final training
item.description: The four astronauts will spend the next months in simulators in Houston.

item.title: Review: a $300 robot vacuum that maps your whole kitchen
item.description: Great mapping, mediocre suction, and an app that wants too many permissions.

item.description: Researchers say the system beats airline estimates by 18 minutes on average.
